name: ntlm-downgrade-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): downgrades the NTLM stack by setting HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\LmCompatibilityLevel to 0 (send LM + NTLM responses) -- legacy challenge/response hashes become crackable at dictionary speeds. The hardened state is 5 (refuse LM and NTLM, NTLMv2 only). Secedit/policy-managed value: harden via Local Security Policy so a policy refresh does not revert a bare reg write. Vars: none. Pairs with a powershell_json check over the same value. Idempotent.
